issues.description: Method de.tum.in.ase.eist.service.PersonService.savePerson(Person): in the TEMPLATE repository this method is declared public (template: src/server/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java line 18). In the SOLUTION repository the same method is declared private (solution: src/server/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java line 20). The SOLUTION's REST resource calls this method (solution: src/server/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java line 42: personService.savePerson(...)). This visibility mismatch (public vs private) will cause a compilation error and contradicts the problem statement guidance to forward REST actions to PersonService, confusing students about the intended service API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of PersonService.savePerson(Person) consistent between template and solution. Restore the method to public in the solution (recommended) so PersonResource can call it, or alternatively change the REST resource to call a public service API. Ensure the service method intended for use by REST resources remains public to match the problem statement and avoid compilation errors.
